title: Map Stealing.

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body: You took a 1 year old OCN map, changed the middle of it, and called it yours. You gave no credit at all to anybody who actually made the map and designed it, you just stole it and modified a few blocks and stamped your name on there. I'm denying your appeal.
